description: This file declares functions for managing DM entry context and operations within a software project, including initialization, cleanup, fault mapping, and validation functions.

methods.name: bbf_ctx_init
methods.description: Initializes the context with a given entry object.

methods.name: bbf_entry_method
methods.description: Performs an operation based on a command.

methods.name: bbf_global_init
methods.description: Performs global initialization with a plugin path.

methods.name: dm_validate_allowed_objects
methods.description: Validates if objects are allowed within the context.

methods.name: adm_entry_object_exists
methods.description: Checks if an entry object exists, marked for removal later.

methods.name: bbf_entry_services
methods.description: Provides entry services based on protocol, commit status, and reload requirement.
